description:
State of a capture (recording, ready, failed) and its kind (logic, analog). Once ready, the measures per pin
    and, for a logic capture, the edges [t_us, pin, v], 2000 from offset; for an analog one, rate_hz and the samples,
    rows [mv_1, ...] in the order of pins (row k at k / rate_hz), 2000 rows from offset. next: the following offset, or
    null. t0_ms: the first sample on the session's clock (ms since the simulation's launch, or since the start of the
    turn on a real bench), null when unknown; t_us and rows count from the capture's start. format="png": the same
    without edges or samples, plus a chart of the signals as an image (from_ms and to_ms, from the capture's start,
    to zoom; 4 per minute).
name: read_capture
title: Read a capture
